$comment: Shared preset contract read by frontend/src/utils/__tests__/presetContract.test.js and backend/app/tests/test_preset_contract.py. A change to a preset's categories, include_metadata_explicit flag, or description must update this file and its summary in the same diff.

presets.name: Kid-Safe / Strict
presets.description: Filters all profanity, vulgar language, crude humor, substance references, and slurs.
presets.summary: Strictest: flags slurs, all profanity, sexual terms, and drug references, plus tracks tagged explicit.

presets.name: Moderate (Recommended)
presets.description: Filters standard explicit language, F-bombs, vulgar sexual references, and slurs (allows mild words like damn/hell).
presets.summary: Radio-edit rules: flags slurs, strong profanity, and sexual terms, plus tracks tagged explicit; allows mild words like damn/hell.

presets.name: Slurs & Hate Speech Only
presets.description: Flags only discriminatory slurs and severely offensive derogatory terms.
presets.summary: Flags only slurs and hate speech; allows other explicit lyrics and ignores explicit tags.

presets.name: Slurs + Strong Language
presets.description: Applies the fixed slur and strong-profanity rules plus your custom blocklist terms. Your blocklist applies under every preset.
presets.summary: Applies the fixed slur and strong-profanity rules plus your custom blocklist terms, which apply under every preset. Also flags tracks tagged explicit.
